name: Bunts (Nadavas)
role: Historic agrarian landed gentry, chieftains (Guthus), and hereditary patrons of Daivasthanas and Yakshagana melas.

name: Billavas (Poojaris)
role: Traditional archers, Ayurvedic herbalists, toddy tappers, and hereditary custodians of Garodis and the Koti-Chennaya lineage.

name: Mogaveeras
region: Coastal belt of DK and Udupi
role: Indigenous marine fisherfolk, maritime navigators, and sole custodians of Bobbariya sea shrines.

name: Shivalli Madhwa Brahmins
role: Scholastic philosophers, Vedic Tantris, and monastic administrators of Ashta Mathas and classical Agamic sanctums.

name: Gowd Saraswat Brahmins (GSB)
role: Historic maritime merchants, temple trustees (Venkataramana temples), and Kaavi art patrons who migrated from Goa in the 16th century.

name: Havyaka Brahmins
role: Traditional arecanut plantation custodians, Vedic priests of Gokarna Mahabaleshwara, and Badagutittu Yakshagana scholars.

name: Jain Communities (Jain Bunts & Shravakas)
role: Historic royal rulers (Alupas, Ajilas, Chowtas), architects of monolithic Gommateshwara statues and Thousand-Pillar Basadis, and hereditary Dharmadhikaris.

name: Nalike, Pambada, and Parava Communities
role: Hereditary shamans, ritual artists, and medium-dancers who alone possess the sacred right to impersonate and channel Daivas in Bootha Kola.

name: Beary Community
role: Historic coastal Muslim trading, seafaring, and timber community rooted in centuries-old syncretic partnerships with regional Hindu temples.
